International Yoga Day Celebrated Across India with Mass Participation

International Yoga Day was observed on June 21, 2026, with widespread participation across India. Prime Minister Narendra Modi led a major event in Kolkata, emphasizing the theme "Yoga for Healthy Ageing." Other celebrations took place in various cities, involving citizens, officials, and public figures, highlighting yoga's role in physical and mental well-being.
